prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The vehicle presents with substantial crush and deformation along the driver-side rear quarter panel, rocker area, and rear door, consistent with the side impact described at the intersection. Structural measurements were taken and the damage pattern lines up with the reported collision geometry. Several shallow scratches on the lower door skin appear older than this loss and have been noted separately. The repair plan calls for replacing the rear door and quarter panel, straightening the rocker, and refinishing the affected panels. Labor hours are slightly elevated for the scope of this damage and will be reviewed with the shop. Invoice line items show no repeated charges.
